title: aaps prompted rebuild when installed on new device, then did not promp when reinstalled on old device. Now 60 days have passed and aaps has not reverted to LGS
symptom: After installing AAPS on a new device, a prompt to rebuild appeared, but when reinstalling on the old device, the notification did not appear. After 72 days, AAPS has not fallen back to LGS as expected.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. A comment suggests it works as designed and that lack of alert might be due to internet connection, but the user disputes this.
fix: The thread suggests updating to the latest release version (3.1.0.3) as it is not a bug but works as designed.
evidence_quote: Latest version of AAPS is 3.1.0.3 so you have to update to latest release version (it's not a bug, it works as designed)
